description:
Adds the typed route decision of LDPC batch decoding, the one place that turns the decode selectors into a route.

## Background

The coding tuning section of `gf2-coding` holds a decode selector family: `lane_min_frames`, `lane_max_edges` and `granules_per_task`, with conservative values that close the lane route. An LDPC batch decoder decodes a wave of frames either one frame at a time on the single-frame decoder or in eight lanes; the lane route exists for the min-sum family only and needs a lane kernel backend.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A typed route decision in the LDPC module maps the occupied lanes of a wave, the edge count, the decoder algorithm and the lane capability to the single-frame route or the lane route.
- [hard] REQ-02: It reads no value outside the decode selector family, and no second threshold for the route exists in the crate.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tests cover both sides of `lane_min_frames` and of `lane_max_edges`, the sum-product algorithm, and an absent lane capability.
- [hard] REQ-04: The route is a closed semantic type, and its rustdoc states the decision rule.
title: Decide the LDPC batch route from the decode selectors
